Cue: Acme release notes command missing since-tag
Text: Append the --since-tag flag with a valid tag or "none" to the release notes command.

Failed:
```
error: E42
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./bin/acme release notes --since-tag none"}
```

Cue: Missing required database configuration for migration script
Text: When calling migrate.sh, include the argument --db with the target database configuration (e.g., --db sqlite:./dev.db) to avoid the "no database configured" error.

Failed:
```
error: no database configured; pass --db sqlite:./dev.db
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./scripts/migrate.sh status --db sqlite:./dev.db"}
```
